entities.name: LocationMeasurementInfo
entities.description: Information element containing field descriptions for location measurement configuration, including parameters for inter-RAT RSTD measurements and NR DL-PRS measurements.

entities.name: carrierFreq
entities.description: The EARFCN value of the carrier received from upper layers for which the UE needs to perform inter-RAT RSTD measurements.

entities.name: measPRS-Offset
entities.description: Indicates the requested gap offset for performing RSTD measurements towards E-UTRA, calculated as the serving cell's number of subframes from SFN=0 mod 40.

entities.name: dl-PRS-PointA
entities.description: The ARFCN value of the carrier received from upper layers for which the UE needs to perform NR DL-PRS measurements.

entities.name: nr-MeasPRS-RepetitionAndOffset
entities.description: Indicates the gap periodicity in ms and offset in number of subframes of the requested measurement gap for performing NR DL-PRS measurements.

entities.name: nr-MeasPRS-length
entities.description: Indicates measurement gap length in ms of the requested measurement gap for performing NR DL-PRS measurements, according to Table 9.1.2-1 in TS 38.133.

relations.description: LocationMeasurementInfo contains the carrierFreq field for inter-RAT RSTD measurements.
LocationMeasurementInfo contains the measPRS-Offset field for RSTD measurement gap offset.
LocationMeasurementInfo contains the dl-PRS-PointA field for NR DL-PRS measurements.
LocationMeasurementInfo contains the nr-MeasPRS-RepetitionAndOffset field for NR DL-PRS measurement gap periodicity and offset.
LocationMeasurementInfo contains the nr-MeasPRS-length field for NR DL-PRS measurement gap length.
